A '''starship''' was once owned by the ace [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Welex Korofu]] before Korofu crashed it while racing through the canyons of [[Endex]]. It was later discovered during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|The Endex Daredevils}}</ref>
